    """Return live display evidence for a detached, nonauthoritative UI preview.

    Saved report JSON and Blender object transforms are not a pose source. The
    caller may retain this detached projection of immutable evidence for drawing, but an edit still
    needs its opening-context checks and a fresh commit_candidate operation.

        raise bridge.BridgeError("Replay the Assembly before placing a visual joint.")
    state = _state(context)
    key = _key(context.scene)
    runtime = _RUNTIME[key]
    owner, document = state.owner_id, state.document_json
    response = assembly_display._validated(
        runtime.get("display_evidence"),
        runtime.get("display_owner_token"),
        lambda: backend_runtime.capture(_backend_context(context)),
    )
    if (
        _RUNTIME.get(key) is not runtime
        or state.owner_id != owner
        or state.document_json != document
    ):
        raise bridge.BridgeError("Assembly display changed while opening the visual joint tool.")
    return response

def _visual_joint_revision(root):
    assert (root / VISUAL_JOINT_FIXTURE).is_file()
    raw = (root / VISUAL_JOINT_FIXTURE).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == VISUAL_JOINT_SHA256
    revision = json.loads(raw)
    assert set(revision) == {"schema", "base_commit", "added", "changed"}
    assert revision["schema"] == "visual-assembly-joint-boundary-v1"
    assert revision["base_commit"] == "edc574e23bdb361e6566915842befb91526abaf2"
    assert set(revision["changed"]) == set(VISUAL_JOINT_ORIGINALS)
    assert set(revision["added"]) == VISUAL_JOINT_ADDED
    assert not VISUAL_JOINT_ADDED & VISUAL_JOINT_ORIGINALS.keys()
    return revision


def _visual_joint_bytes(root, name, data=None):
    """Undo only the finite visual joint UI delta before every historical guard."""
    data = (root / name).read_bytes() if data is None else data
    if name not in VISUAL_JOINT_ORIGINALS:
        return data
    expected = VISUAL_JOINT_ORIGINALS[name]
    if (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == expected:
        return data
    revision = _visual_joint_revision(root)
    if name == "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py":
        label = b"VISUAL_JOINT_" + b'SHA256 = "'
        slot = label + VISUAL_JOINT_SHA256.encode("ascii") + b'"'
        assert data.count(label) == data.count(slot) == 1
        data = data.replace(slot, label + b"0" * 64 + b'"')
    return _integration_restore_entry(data, revision["changed"][name], expected)


def visual_joint_originals(root):
    """Seal each explicit addition and restore the exact edc574e source and guards."""
    revision = _visual_joint_revision(root)
    for name, entry in revision["added"].items():
        assert set(entry) == {"bytes", "sha256"}
        assert type(entry["bytes"]) is int and entry["bytes"] > 0
        data = (root / name).read_bytes()
        assert (len(data), hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()) == (entry["bytes"], entry["sha256"])
    return VISUAL_JOINT_ADDED, {
        name: _visual_joint_bytes(root, name) for name in VISUAL_JOINT_ORIGINALS
    }

def test_visual_joint_inner_controls_keep_finite_paths_hunks_and_before_pins(monkeypatch, mutation):

    guard = ROOT / "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    read = Path.read_bytes
    revision = json.loads(read(fixture))
    name = "tests/unit/test_arc_profile_native_end_cap.py"
    entry = revision["changed"][name]
    hunk = entry["hunks"][0]
    added = revision["added"][sorted(VISUAL_JOINT_ADDED)[0]]
    if mutation == "schema":
        revision["schema"] = "unreviewed"
    elif mutation == "base":
        revision["base_commit"] = "f" * 40
    elif mutation == "extra_key":
        revision["allow_other_paths"] = True
    elif mutation == "missing_changed":
        revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "missing_added":
        revision["added"].pop(sorted(VISUAL_JOINT_ADDED)[0])
    elif mutation == "changed_path":
        revision["changed"]["tests/unit/../unreviewed.py"] = revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation == "added_path":
        revision["added"]["../unreviewed.py"] = revision["added"].pop(sorted(VISUAL_JOINT_ADDED)[0])
    elif mutation == "core_path":
        revision["changed"]["src/mechanical_cad/kernel_ocp.py"] = revision["changed"].pop(name)
    elif mutation in {"original_hash", "reviewed_hash"}:
        entry[mutation.replace("_hash", "_sha256")] = "f" * 64
    elif mutation in {"original_length", "reviewed_length"}:
        entry[mutation.replace("_length", "_bytes")] = True
    elif mutation == "entry_key":
        entry["exempt"] = True
    elif mutation == "empty_hunks":
        entry["hunks"] = []
    elif mutation == "hunk_key":
        hunk["skip_validation"] = True
    elif mutation == "start_bool":
        hunk["new_start"] = True
    elif mutation == "start_negative":
        hunk["new_start"] = -1
    elif mutation == "end_before_start":
        hunk["new_end"] = hunk["new_start"] - 1
    elif mutation == "end_overflow":
        hunk["new_end"] = entry["reviewed_bytes"] + 1
    elif mutation == "replacement":
        hunk["replacement"] += "# altered reviewed bytes\n"
    elif mutation == "original":
        hunk["original"] += "# altered before bytes\n"
    elif mutation == "duplicate_hunk":
        entry["hunks"].insert(1, dict(hunk))
    elif mutation == "reversed_hunks":
        assert len(entry["hunks"]) > 1
        entry["hunks"].reverse()
    elif mutation == "forged_original":
        before = expected[1][name] + b"\n# forged historical source\n"
        current = read(guard).replace(VISUAL_JOINT_SHA256.encode(), b"0" * 64)
        entry["original_bytes"] = len(before)
        entry["original_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()
        entry["hunks"] = [
            {
                "new_start": 0,
                "new_end": len(current),
                "original": before.decode(),
                "replacement": current.decode(),
            }
        ]
    elif mutation == "added_hash":
        added["sha256"] = "f" * 64
    elif mutation == "added_length":
        added["bytes"] = True
    elif mutation == "added_key":
        added["original_sha256"] = "f" * 64
    else:
        assert mutation == "equivalent"
    raw = (json.dumps(revision, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode()
    assert raw != read(fixture)
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    data = read(guard)
